title: Plot generation scripts for permanent benchmarks
description:
Add plot generation scripts that turn the criterion JSON outputs (T10, S1, S2, S3, S4, S5) into publication-grade figures.

## Background

The reproducible benchmark artefact (S6) needs PNG/SVG plots of: (a) log-time vs $n$ for the F_3 permanent paths (reference, bipedal, SIMD, parallel), (b) parallel scaling vs core count, (c) AVX2-vs-AVX-512 cross-CPU bars, (d) GPU vs CPU crossover. This issue lands the plotting scripts under `scripts/plot_permanent_*.py` (matplotlib) or `scripts/plot_permanent_*.rs` (plotters), reading from the criterion JSON paths in `target/criterion/` or the simulation CSVs in `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/`.

The choice of matplotlib vs plotters is left to the implementer; the constraint is that the script must be deterministically reproducible.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `scripts/plot_permanent_*` scripts exist (matplotlib or plotters; document the choice in the script header).
- [ ] [hard] At least four figure types are produced: log-time vs $n$, parallel-scaling, cross-CPU comparison, GPU-vs-CPU.
- [ ] [hard] Figures are written to `dev/benchmarks/gf2_algebra_permanent/figures/` with deterministic file names.
- [ ] [hard] Running the scripts twice produces bit-identical output (after timestamp normalisation, if any).
- [ ] [hard] Scripts read from the conventional CSV locations recorded in S1/S2/S3/S4/S5; missing input data produces a clear error, not a partial figure.
